blocks.text: We recommend Option 3 (Daily time rule) and Option 1 (AI-drafted timesheets) together. The rule fixes when time is logged; the drafts fix the effort and the forgetting. Together they save an estimated 35 hours a week ($105,840 a year) for $11,120 in year one, a payback of 1.3 months.

blocks.label: Option 2: PSA time module
blocks.text: Follow-on to AI-drafted timesheets: Once the PSA is live, drafts flow into it instead of the old time tool; no extra savings are counted, to avoid double counting. It arrives with the PSA tool chosen for staffing (Staffing blind spots).

The 3 recommendations cost $79,520 in year one and save an estimated $589,680 a year, a combined payback of 1.6 months. From year two, ongoing costs are $37,920 a year and the net benefit is about $551,760 a year. At 70% adoption, the 195 gross hours become about 137 effective hours a week: 48% of the 283 hours lost to the bottlenecks in scope.
